title: Coverage-Aware DSE Panel
description: Framework for building financial panels that records how much of each instrument's history actually exists, then measures how coverage choices distort volatility estimates. Ships the panel, the metadata schema, and the replication experiments.

title: AgriPriceBD Benchmark
description: Seven forecasting approaches compared on a new daily commodity price dataset for Bangladesh: classical baselines, Prophet, BiLSTM, and a Transformer with a Time2Vec ablation. Negative results on Time2Vec and Informer are reported rather than hidden.

title: Stock Transformer with Time2Vec
description: Transformer encoder with learned time representation for next-day price prediction on the Dhaka Stock Exchange. Full training code accompanying the IJCIA paper; the most cited of my first-author work.

title: ANCHOLIK-NER
description: Regional Bangla named entity corpus built under the REG-NER grant, with annotation guidelines and baseline taggers. Published in PLOS ONE.

title: Vashantor
description: Parallel corpora for translating Bangla regional dialects into standard Bangla, with baseline neural models across several dialect pairs.

title: VR-FuseNet
description: Fuses heterogeneous fundus image sources for diabetic retinopathy grading and reports interpretability alongside accuracy. Published in Biomedical Materials & Devices.

title: BIDWESH
description: Hate speech annotations for regional Bangla, covering dialectal expressions that standard-Bangla classifiers systematically miss.
